title: api-gateway: routing + streaming proxy buffer and payload limits for OpenAI-compat tool calls
author: Lena Park
description: Motivation: customers observed intermittent stalls and dropped tool/function-calling events when routing to dedicated backends under high-concurrency workloads and when proxied through the OpenAI compatibility layer. This PR makes three coordinated changes: 1) tighten routing rules to prefer same-region low-latency pools for streaming tool calls, 2) introduce conservative streaming proxy buffer sizing and backpressure signalling for large payloads, and 3) add payload size gating and graceful 413s with guidance for SDKs and retry semantics. Changes are backwards-compatible for normal generation calls but adjust behavior for streaming tool/function calling over the OpenAI compatibility endpoint. Checklist: [x] routing policy change and tests, [x] streaming proxy buffer adjustments and unit tests, [x] payload gating and client-facing erroring + docs, [x] e2e flaky-case regression test, [x] release notes. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and metrics to monitor. Important notes: this alters per-route runtime default buffers; operators on Dedicated/private deployments can override via config/limits.yaml. SDK teams were notified to implement client-side retry/backoff for 413-and-retry recommendations. CI: some flaky integration windows were addressed by increasing test timeouts; all pipelines green at merge.

review_comments: Diego Martinez (review): the routing predicate looks good but please add a fallback when same-region pools are saturated to avoid blackholing requests. Also add a metric for routed_vs_fallback_count.
Lena Park (author): added fallback path to cross-region tiered routing and incremented metric routed_vs_fallback_count in telemetry. See commit 7a4e8c1.

Ava Chen (review): streaming_proxy buffer ceiling should be configurable per-deployment; mark default conservatively and document. Also ensure header X-Redwood-Buffer-State is emitted to help debugging.
Lena Park (author): made buffer_max configurable via limits.yaml and added X-Redwood-Buffer-State header. Unit tests assert header presence and behavior under backpressure.
Rishi Kapoor (approver): verified integration tests locally and load-tested a 200RPS scenario. Approving; small suggestion to add a brief note in release notes about SDK retry guidance.
Lena Park (author): added release notes blurb per Rishi and updated docs/openai-compat.md with sample SDK retry pseudo-code.
diff_snippets: --- a/services/api-gateway/handler/routing.go +++ b/services/api-gateway/handler/routing.go @@ -120,6 +120,22 @@ func selectBackend(req) { + // prefer same-region low-latency pools for streaming tool calls + if req.IsStreamingToolCall() && pool.InRegion(req.Region) { +     candidate = pickLowLatencyPool(poolList) + }

--- a/services/api-gateway/proxy/streaming_proxy.go +++ b/services/api-gateway/proxy/streaming_proxy.go @@ -45,7 +45,28 @@ func handleStream(ctx,w,r) { + // add conservative adaptive buffer to avoid stalls on large payloads + bufMax := cfg.StreamingProxy.BufferMax // defaults to 256KB + if payloadSize > bufMax { +     w.WriteHeader(413) +     w.Write([]byte("Request payload too large for streaming tool call; see docs/openai-compat for guidance")) +     return + }

--- a/services/api-gateway/config/limits.yaml +++ b/services/api-gateway/config/limits.yaml @@ -1,6 +1,10 @@ streaming_proxy:
+  buffer_max: 262144 # bytes, operator overrideable
+  backpressure_header: X-Redwood-Buffer-State
 routing:
   priority: [same-region, tiered-cross-region]
release_notes: api-gateway: improved routing for streaming tool/function calls; added adaptive streaming proxy buffer and payload gating. Operators can tune streaming_proxy.buffer_max. SDKs should implement 413-and-retry with backoff. This reduces intermittent streaming stalls and dropped tool call events under high contention.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for routing predicate and streaming proxy buffer behavior. Integration test simulates concurrent tool-call streaming against dedicated pools and asserts no dropped events for the regression window. Load test (200RPS) validated reduced stall rate and measurable fallback routing metrics.
ops_notes: Rollout plan: deploy to staging, monitor metric routed_vs_fallback_count and streaming_proxy.buffer_state.*. Roll to canary workers for Dedicated, then full rollout. Default buffer_max conservative; increase if memory allows. Watch for client 413 errors and coordinate with SDK teams for backoff changes.
